title: Morris 1895 — gap registry and provenance schema for Theo's CSS contract
purpose: Provides a machine-readable gap registry (gaps.json) and JSON Schema (gap-schema.json) that formalizes the assumption ledger from artifact 69ce2872. Each gap entry records its source line, what evidence is missing, severity, and whether it is encodable in CSS. Designed to be loaded alongside validator.js so that any downstream tool can enumerate open provenance questions without re-reading the prose README. This is source publication only; not executed.
